name: PopQA
intro: PopQA 是包含 14,267 条问题的开放域事实问答基准，通过 16 种 Wikidata 关系覆盖热门与长尾实体。它为每题保存全部可接受宾语及别名，并附加维基百科访问量，用于分析参数记忆、检索增强与自适应检索的准确率如何随实体流行度变化。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Johns Hopkins University
build_method: Wikidata三元组抽样, 人工关系模板, 全宾语与别名扩展, 页面访问量标注
metric: Exact-substring Accuracy, Per-relation Accuracy, Popularity correlation
eval_feature: 16种关系, 热门与长尾实体, 多答案别名, 维基页面访问量, 参数与非参数记忆对比
build_method_en: Wikidata triple sampling, manual relation templates, all-object and alias expansion, page-view annotation
eval_feature_en: 16 relations, popular and long-tail entities, multi-answer aliases, Wikipedia page views, parametric versus non-parametric memory
intro_en: PopQA is an open-domain factual QA benchmark with 14,267 questions across 16 Wikidata relations and both popular and long-tail entities. It stores all acceptable objects and aliases and adds Wikipedia page views, enabling analysis of how parametric memory, retrieval augmentation, and adaptive retrieval accuracy vary with entity popularity.
metric_en: Exact-substring Accuracy, Per-relation Accuracy, Popularity correlation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2212.10511v4 PopQA construction and evaluation sections plus the official AlexTMallen/adaptive-retrieval repository. The authors select 16 Wikidata relations and randomly sample subject-relation-object triples over a broad popularity range. A natural-language template is manually written for each relation and instantiated with the subject. Acceptable answers include every entity E satisfying the same subject-relation-E fact and their aliases, with Wikidata IDs or URIs, Wikipedia titles, relation types, and subject/object metadata. Monthly Wikipedia page views provide the popularity signal. The final dataset has 14,267 open-domain questions. Models receive no evidence paragraph and are evaluated in zero- or few-shot settings, with vanilla parametric memory compared against BM25, Contriever, GenRead, and adaptive retrieval variants. A prediction is correct when any exact gold-answer string appears as a substring. Results report overall and per-relation Accuracy and analyze correlation with log entity popularity.
